features.quote: Default budget = 30 turns, with an early-stop: if the model issues `submit` with a give-up note, end
features.justification_quote: This caps cost on graceful-failers (cheap) and only spends full budget on spirals/thrashers

features.quote: it gives the model an explicit, low-friction off-ramp
features.justification_quote: Whether/when it uses `submit` to give up is itself a measured signal

features.quote: If you believe the task cannot be completed, use `submit` to explain why
